models_evaluated: MRI-based deep learning model for AD (previously developed, trained on North American data)

links.outcome: External performance of North American-trained AD model on Chinese SILCODE cohort without retraining
links.effect: AUC 91.3% for AD classification with sensitivity 95.2%; identified 86.7% of individuals at risk of progression more than 5 years in advance, without retraining or fine-tuning.
links.quote: The model — initially trained on North American data — demonstrated robust cross-ethnic generalization, without any retraining or fine-tuning, achieving an AUC of 91.3% in AD classification with a sensitivity of 95.2%.

unlisted_practices: Interpretable brain risk maps to identify AD subtypes
Correlating AI risk scores with plasma biomarkers and cognitive measures
Open-source release and free online deployment of the model

screen.reason: Evaluates cross-ethnic external validation and progression prediction of a previously developed MRI deep learning model on a large cohort, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
